lines.japanese: 「おお、成田。おまえ何してんの」
lines.english: “Hey, Narita. What're you doing here?”

lines.japanese: 「え、なにがっすか」
lines.english: “Huh? What do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 工事現場に顔を出そうと思って駅前で時間を潰していたら、私服姿のプリン頭に出くわした。訂正、私服姿なのに作業服のプリン頭に出くわした。
lines.english: I had been killing time by the station before dropping in at the construction site when I ran into Pudding Head in plain clothes. Correction: even though he was off duty, Pudding Head was still in his work clothes.

lines.japanese: やつが言うには、今日は現場が休みの日だったらしい。ヒゲカンも来ないし、プリン頭もこれからパチ打って帰るとのことだった。
lines.english: According to him, the site was closed today. Beardy wasn't coming in, and Pudding Head was going to play some pachinko and head home.

lines.japanese: 「くそう、完全に無駄足じゃないか……」
lines.english: “Damn it. I came all this way for nothing...”

lines.japanese: 飛びこみ作業員の辛いところだ。俺は実際に現場まで行ってみないと、日程が確認できないんだ。俺はプリン頭に礼だけは言って、パイプベンチに腰を下ろした。
lines.english: Such was the plight of a day laborer who wandered in off the street. I had no way to check the schedule without actually visiting the site. I thanked Pudding Head for the information, at least, and sat down on a pipe-frame bench.

lines.japanese: こういう日に限ってマルチネスの露店もさっさと引きあげてる。仕方ない、適当にぶらついて家に帰るか。
lines.english: Of course this would be the one day Martinez packed up her stall early, too. Oh well. I could wander around for a while, then go home.

lines.japanese: 横断歩道で信号を待ちながら、昼に学校で山科と話したことを思いだした。そういえば太鼓の音が聞こえない。
lines.english: As I waited for the light at a crosswalk, I remembered my conversation with Yamashina at school that afternoon. Come to think of it, I couldn't hear any drums.

lines.japanese: ここのとこ、この時間に駅前に来ることもないから気づかなかったけど、ハリュー・クロードは学校で作業をしてる間もガード下で演奏を続けていたんだろうか。
lines.english: I had not been around the station at this hour lately, so it had never occurred to me: had Haryu Claude kept performing under the overpass all this time, even while working at the school?

lines.japanese: ちょっと見にいってみよっかな。好奇心が動いて、俺の足は自然と家とは別の方角に向いていた。
lines.english: Maybe I'd go take a look. Curiosity stirred, and my feet naturally carried me away from home.

lines.japanese: が、結論から言うとそれは失敗だった。
lines.english: In the end, that was a mistake.

lines.japanese: 「イェア、ようこそ成田君！　そりゃ探しても見つからねえはずだぜ、ＶＩＰな登場の場を待ち構えてたんだもんナー！　全くイルなドッグだぜ、ハッハー！」
lines.english: “Yeah! Welcome, Narita! No wonder we couldn’t find you—you were waiting for the perfect moment to make a VIP entrance! You one ill dog, hah-hah!”

lines.japanese: 「ア、ア、アァニキイイイイイ・ヤッ！　アニキが来てくれるとは思わなかったじぇいっ！　じぇい、じぇいっ！　アニキが来てくれれば、家畜の鶏なんざ何匹いたって、豚のエ、エ、エじょわぁぁぁああああッ！」
lines.english: “B-b-Big Brooooo—yeah! Never thought you’d come for us, jay! Jay, jay! With you here, however many barnyard chickens they’ve got, the pigs can p-p-p—waaaaaaagh!”

lines.japanese: そこは両軍睨みあいの真っ只中だったからだ。
lines.english: Because I had walked straight into the middle of a standoff between two armies.

lines.japanese: しかも来ると同時にフレイムバーズのハゲからよく来てくれたハッハ、ハッハー、サンキゥブロウなどと歓迎され、両軍の不穏な空気の中心に放りこまれていた。
lines.english: The moment I arrived, the bald Flame Bird welcomed me with cries of “Glad you could make it, hah-hah, hah-hah! Thanks, bro!” and flung me into the very center of the hostility between them.

lines.japanese: 「つーかなんでこんなことになってんだ」
lines.english: “How the hell did this happen?”

lines.japanese: 「それが聞いてくれよ成田君、この糞タレどもが、一度は許してやった俺らの恩忘れて、反乱なんざ起こしやがったんだビッチアス！」
lines.english: “Listen to this, Narita. These shitbirds forgot how we let 'em off the first time and rose up against us! Bitch-ass!”

lines.japanese: 「ぶひゃひゃひゃひゃ、な、な、なに言っちゃってんだかこここの、ブブブ豚ァ？　俺ら最初からおまえらなんか眼中にありませんからァ！　ファッキン！」
lines.english: “Buh-hyah-hyah-hyah! Wh-wh-what's this p-p-pig even saying? You were never on our radar in the first place! Fuckin'!”

lines.japanese: 「ああそう……」
lines.english: “Uh-huh...”

lines.japanese: 要はくだらない内輪もめか。だったらそんなもんに付きあってやる義理はない。
lines.english: So it was an idiotic internal squabble. In that case, I had no obligation to indulge them.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあアレだ、おまえらお巡りさんの世話になるような真似だけはすんなよ。そんじゃバイバイ」
lines.english: “All right, then. Just don't do anything that'll land you in the care of our friendly neighborhood police. Bye-bye.”

lines.japanese: 俺は片手を上げて、このアホしかいない場から速やかに立ち去ろうとした。
lines.english: I raised one hand and tried to make a quick exit from this gathering of idiots.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょっとどこ行くのよアニキィ！　あんた俺らの旗頭でしょォー？　ほら早くこっち来てよア～ニキィィ～！」
lines.english: “W-wait, where are you going, Big Bro? You’re supposed to be the one flying our flag! Come on, get over here, Big Broooo!”
“Haaah?!”

lines.japanese: 初耳だった。いつの間に俺がＲ－ウイングの頭になってんだ。
lines.english: News to me. Since when was I the head of R-Wing?

lines.japanese: 「え、えええ～っ！　なに、成田チャンＲ－ウイングの味方なのォ！？　ちょっと待ってよ、そりゃナイんじゃないの？　今まで散々俺たちの相談乗ってくれたのにさぁ！」
lines.english: “W-whaaat?! Narita, you're on R-Wing's side?! Hold on, man, that's cold! After all the advice you've given us!”

lines.japanese: 「そッスよ隼人先輩！　俺、隼人先輩は自分ら裏切るような真似するひとだとは思ってねッスけどォ！　ンーなことされたら許せねッスわ！　自分刺し違えてでも許さねえッス！」
lines.english: “He's right, Hayato! I never took you for the kinda guy who'd betray us! If you pull that shit, I won't let it stand! I'll take you down even if it kills me too!”

lines.japanese: 「ままま待て、俺はＲ－ウイングに味方する義理もなけりゃ、なんの借りもねえっつうの」
lines.english: “W-w-wait! I don't owe R-Wing a damn thing, and I've got no reason to take their side!”

lines.japanese: 俺は両軍のほぼ中心に居たが、両手を振りつつＲ－ウイングの側から離れようとした。
lines.english: I stood almost exactly between the two camps. Waving both hands, I tried to edge away from R-Wing's side.

lines.japanese: 「ひいっ！？　う、ウソでしょ成田クン、それはないよぉ！　だって僕たちの集会にも来てくれたし、仲良くしてくれてたじゃない！　狂夜だってほらこんなに懐いてるしさぁ」
lines.english: “Eek! Y-you can't mean that, Narita! You came to our meetings, and you were so nice to us! And just look how attached Kyoya is to you!”

lines.japanese: 「ななな成田ァ……君の目が僕を映すことがないのなら、この眼球だけを君のいる部屋に飾ってほしい……君の心がＲ－ウイングの元にないのなら、その心臓を抉ってしまいたい……」
lines.english: “N-N-Narita... If your eyes will never hold my reflection, I want you to display these eyeballs in the room where you live... If your heart does not belong to R-Wing, I want to gouge it from your chest...”

lines.japanese: 「ば、バカ、早まるな。違う、俺は別におまえらの敵じゃないしなんの干渉もする気はねえの」
lines.english: “D-don't be stupid. Don't do anything rash. That's not what I meant. I'm not your enemy, and I don't plan to interfere with either side.”

lines.japanese: 俺は腰を折りまげながら、慌てて元居た位置に戻った。
lines.english: Bent nearly double, I hurried back to where I had started.

lines.japanese: 「オイ成田君、それで結局あんたはどっちの味方なんだい？　返答次第によっちゃ、その瞬間から戦闘開始だァ。ここが戦場、あんたが大将、俺燃やす闘気あんた決断の時」
lines.english: “Hey, Narita. So whose side are you on? Give the wrong answer and the fighting starts that instant. Here's the battle, you're the general; my spirit's fire—your answer's final.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよアニキィ！　ここまで来て、敵でも味方でもないってないでしょー？　ほらほら早くこっち来てプリィ～ン」
lines.english: “He's right, Big Brooo! You can't come this far and say you're neither friend nor foe, can you? C'mon, hurry over here, pleeease!”

lines.japanese: 「く、くくっ、こいつら……」
lines.english: “G-grrr, you people...”

lines.japanese: フリーラップを刻むデブと飛びまわるパンク小僧にまとわりつかれ、分厚いと自認している俺の血管もさすがにブチリと音を立てた。
lines.english: A fat man laying down freestyle bars and a punk brat bouncing off the walls both swarmed around me. Even the blood vessel I prided myself on for its durability finally burst with an audible pop.

lines.japanese: 「ヘイＹＯ、成田君！　そんな連中に一蹴りかまして早くこっち来いよ！」
lines.english: “Hey, yo, Narita! Kick those fools aside and get over here!”

lines.japanese: 「ぶしゃしゃしゃしゃ！　アァニキ～！　あんた俺たちのののみかっ、みか、みかどぅわわわばばばぁぁばばばぶわあああぁぁっ！！」
lines.english: “Buh-shah-shah-shah! Brooootherrr! You're our a-a-ally, our ally, our al-al-al-alalalalalagh!”

lines.japanese: 「うっ」
lines.english: “Ghk.”

lines.japanese: 「うるるるるさいわあっ！　フロムＵＳＡもＵＫパンクも俺の趣味じゃねえんだよ！」
lines.english: “Sh-sh-sh-shut the hell up! Neither your American hip-hop act nor his UK punk act is my thing!”

lines.japanese: 俺は両手をぶんがぶんが振りまわして両軍の間を駆けまわった。
lines.english: I windmilled both arms and rampaged back and forth between the armies.

lines.japanese: 「つーか俺は無所属だって、最初から両方に何べんも何べんも何ッべんも言っ！　てん！　だろッ！　ほらもう帰してください、僕お腹空いたんです、ふーッ！　ふーッ！」
lines.english: “I've told both sides over and over and over again from the very start: I am unaffiliated! Now please let me go home. I'm hungry. Hffff! Hffff!”

lines.japanese: 俺が全身を逆毛立てながら四足歩行で威嚇すると、恐れをなしたのか両軍ともやや引きさがった。
lines.english: I dropped to all fours, every hair on my body standing on end, and tried to intimidate them. Perhaps it worked, because both armies edged back.

lines.japanese: 「つ、つったってよ成田君、じゃあアンタどうすんだい、俺たち置いてこのまま帰んのかい？」
lines.english: “B-but Narita, what're you gonna do, then? Just leave us here and go home?”

lines.japanese: 「そそ、そうだよアニキィ！　俺らだってこんだけ人数揃えて黙って帰るワケにもいかねえし、この豚ミンチにしてソーセージ作らなきゃ収まりつかないよォ？」
lines.english: “Y-yeah, Big Bro! We brought all these guys; we can’t just slink home. Not until we’ve ground this pig into sausage!”

lines.japanese: 「ハッハー、これだから日本のお坊ちゃんはいけねえ。そこのネズミちゃん、自分がロスに生まれなかったことを金髪ボインな女神に感謝しな。でなきゃチーズを齧ろうとして脳天を撃ち抜かれてるトコだァ」
lines.english: “Hah-hah! That's the trouble with spoiled little Japanese boys. Listen, mouse: thank the blond, big-titted goddess you weren't born in L.A. Otherwise you'd reach for the cheese and catch a bullet through the skull.”

lines.japanese: 「うひはひは、な、なに言ってんのこのぶぶぶ黒豚ァ？　あんな糞汚い街だだだ誰が住むんだってェ？　ぶひゃひゃひゃカン違いしちゃダメよォ～、ドブネズミしか居ない街の間違いでしょォ～ン？」
lines.english: “Uh-heh-heh! Wh-wh-what's this b-b-black pig babbling about? Who'd wanna live in that filthy shithole? Buh-hyah-hyah! Get it straight—it's a city with nothing but sewer rats!”

lines.japanese: 「シット！　テメェ、俺のことはともかく、故郷を馬鹿にされたんじゃ黙っちゃいられねェゼ。クククこんなに血が滾るのはロスでギャングと抗争したとき以来だろ、Ｅｈ？」
lines.english: “Shit! Say what you want about me, but nobody insults my hometown. Heh-heh... Haven't felt my blood boil like this since I went to war with the gangs of L.A., eh?”

lines.japanese: 「うっひゃー！　キタキタ、ＬＲが本気になってもーた！　おまえら知らんからね、もうギバラ西公園戦争のときみたいに全員ぶっ潰すまで止まらないかもネ～」
lines.english: “Whoo-boy! There it is—LR's gone serious! You kids don't know what that means. He might not stop till he's flattened every last one of you, just like the Gibara West Park War!”

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃははは、おまえらさっさと謝った方がいンじゃないのォ～？　でないとマジ泣かすよ？　ま、根性見せたら、一、二発でカンベンしてあげっかもしンねえけどォ！」
lines.english: “Gyah-hah-hah! Better apologize while you still can! Otherwise we'll seriously make you cry. Course, if you show some guts, we might let you off after one or two hits!”

lines.japanese: 「というワケだ成田君、アンタがいくら言おうと俺らはもう止まらねえ。まあ今回は立会人として最後まで見届けるくらいはして……」
lines.english: “So there you have it, Narita. Say whatever you want—we ain't stopping now. Least you can do is stay and witness the whole—”

lines.japanese: 「あ、もしもしお巡りさんですか。ここに動物園から抜けだした熊がいるんですけど迎えに来てくれませんか」
lines.english: “Hello, police? There's a bear here that escaped from the zoo. Could you come and collect it?”

lines.japanese: <8>\「ＮＯォォォ！　待てよオイィィ！」
lines.english: “Nooooo! Wait, damn it!”

lines.japanese: 振りむいたハゲがすっ飛んできて、俺の携帯電話をひったくるようにかすめとった。
lines.english: The bald man wheeled around and came flying at me, snatching the phone from my hand.

lines.japanese: 「こら邪魔をするな、今度は保健所に電話するぞ」
lines.english: “Hey, don’t interfere. Next I’m calling animal control.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとォ、何よ、何で邪魔すンのよ成田チャン！　別に俺らがバトルしても迷惑かけないでしょォ？」
lines.english: “Come on, Narita! What're you getting in the way for? It's not like our battle's gonna bother anybody!”

lines.japanese: 「そっスよ！　味方してくれねンなら、せめて中立の立場とってくださいよ！」
lines.english: “Exactly! If you won't take our side, at least stay neutral!”

lines.japanese: 「いやバリバリ柳木原一般市民の皆様の味方だけど。どう考えても中立な選択だろ。ベストアンサーだろ」
lines.english: “I'm firmly on the side of Yanagihara's ordinary citizens, thanks. Calling the police is plainly the neutral choice. Best answer there is.”

lines.japanese: 「くっ、なんてこった。こいつはサプライズ、とても以前の成田君とは思えねえぜ……」
lines.english: “Damn... What a surprise. Hard to believe you're the same Narita we knew before...”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃ五分の四は別人だからな」
lines.english: “Well, four fifths of me is somebody else.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なんすか？」
lines.english: “Huh? What's that mean?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでもない。とにかくこれで手も腹も出ないだろ。はい解散」
lines.english: “Nothing. Anyway, now none of you can lift a finger—or stick out a gut. Dismissed.”

lines.japanese: 俺はぱんぱんと手を二回叩いたが、どいつもこいつもうなだれたハムスターのような顔をして一歩も動こうとしなかった。
lines.english: I clapped my hands twice, but every last one of them hung his head like a dejected hamster and refused to move an inch.

lines.japanese: 「な、なんだ、そんな物悲しそうな顔で見るな。なんだか悪いことした気になってくるじゃないか……」
lines.english: “W-what? Don't look at me with those tragic little faces. You're making me feel like I did something wrong...”

lines.japanese: 「だってよゥ……」
lines.english: “But, maaan...”

lines.japanese: 「せっかく集まったのに……」
lines.english: “We all came out here...”

lines.japanese: 「楽しみにしてたのに……」
lines.english: “We were looking forward to it...”

lines.japanese: こいつら……。
lines.english: These people...

lines.japanese: 要はお祭り騒ぎがしたいだけじゃないか。相変わらずロクな遊び方ができない連中だ。
lines.english: They only wanted an excuse to turn this into a festival. As ever, they had no idea how to have fun without causing trouble.

lines.japanese: しかもしょんぼりしてるくせにがっちり出口を封鎖してる。これじゃ帰ることも出来ない。
lines.english: Worse, despite their dejection, they had the exits thoroughly sealed. I couldn't even leave.

lines.japanese: 「分かった。立会人じゃなくて仲介人ならやってやるから、もっと平和的なことで決着つけろおまえら」
lines.english: “Fine. I won't be your witness, but I'll mediate. Settle this with something more peaceful.”

lines.japanese: 「ラブ＆ピースだってえ？　そいつはムリだぜ成田君」
lines.english: “Love and peace, you say? Can't do it, Narita.”

lines.japanese: 「そうそう、俺らだって裏切った連中を簡単に許すわけにいかないじゃん」
lines.english: “Yeah. We can't exactly forgive the guys who betrayed us that easily.”

lines.japanese: 「だからもっと健全な……そうだ、スポーツとかそんなん」
lines.english: “I said something healthier... Like a sport, maybe.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ空手でどッスか！　自分そんだったら何人でもやりますよ！」
lines.english: “How about karate! I'll take on as many of 'em as they want!”

lines.japanese: 「それじゃ意味ないだろうが。もっと公平に決着をつけられる方法を考えろ」
lines.english: “That defeats the whole point. Think of something that can settle this fairly.”

lines.japanese: 「だからよ成田君、そんなモンあるわきゃねェだろ。俺たちゃケンカしに来てんだぜ、Ｅｈ？」
lines.english: “That's what I'm telling you, Narita. Nothing like that exists. We came here for a fight, eh?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよアニキィ！　こんなやつらと話しあうことなんか、俺たちには一っつもネェ！　ファッキン！」
lines.english: “That’s right, Big Bro! We’ve got nothing to talk about with these guys! Fuckin’!”

lines.japanese: 「ンだとクソガキィ！　ブッチンいっちゃうぞダボが！　テメエさっきっから口ばっか達者だなァ、アァ～ン？」
lines.english: “What'd you say, you little shit?! I'll snap, you dumbass! Been running your mouth this whole time, haven't you? Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、それだ」
lines.english: “Oh. That's it.”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: そのとき神が降りてきて、俺は平和的且つ公平に解決する方法を思いついた。
lines.english: At that moment, a god descended upon me, bearing a peaceful and equitable solution.

lines.japanese: 「あー、ごほん、ごほん、それではいいかね諸君。要はおまえらお互いに言いたいことが溜まってるから鬱憤が積もるんだよ」
lines.english: “Ahem. Ahem. Now listen, gentlemen. The problem is that you've both got things you want to say, and bottling them up is making the resentment fester.”

lines.japanese: 「つーワケで、おまえらお互いに言いたいこと言ってすっきりしろ。真剣だべり大会みたいなもんだ。俺がおまえらの言い分を聞いてどっちが正しいか判定してやる」
lines.english: “So say everything you want to say and get it out of your systems. Think of it as a Serious Gabfest. I'll hear both sides and rule on who's right.”

lines.japanese: 「Ｈｕｈ、オーケイ成田君、アンタの言いたいことはよく分かったぜ、要はフリーラップでバトルをしろってことだろ、Ｅｈ？　さすがは成田君、こいつは俺のために用意されたステージだ、ハッハー！」
lines.english: “Huh. Okay, Narita, I get you. You want us to battle in freestyle. Eh? Knew you had vision. This stage was built for me! Hah-hah!”

lines.japanese: 「ぶしゃしゃしゃしゃ、さっすがアニキィ～！　つまりケンカ方式の対バンみたいなもんでしょ？　んイェス！　俺のビートでこいつらまとめてブッ殺しちゃうからぁ、アニキも聞いててちょモランマ△」
lines.english: “Buh-shah-shah-shah! That’s our Big Bro! So it’s like a battle of the bands, only fighting, right? Yes! I’ll slaughter the lot of ’em with my beat, so listen up, Broverest!”

lines.japanese: 「ちなみに公序良俗に反した発言は厳禁だからな。めっちゃ減点するから、言葉選びには気をつけろよ」
lines.english: “One condition: anything contrary to public morals is strictly forbidden. It'll cost you major points, so choose your words carefully.”

lines.japanese: 「イェア、任せなマイブロウ。いつでもいいぜ、このソウル待ちかねたこのルール、俺のクールまさに皆へのコール」
lines.english: “Yeah, leave it to me, my bro. Ready any time—my soul craved this rule, my style stays cool, this call goes out to all of you.”

lines.japanese: 「♪ギュ、ギュ、ギュ、ギュイーン！　俺の、チュー、ニング、かん・ぺき・だじぇいっ！　いつ、でも、準備、でき・てる・じぇいっ！　ギュイイーン！」
lines.english: “♪ Gyu-gyu-gyu-gyu-gyueeeen! My tu—ning—is per-fect, jay! I'm al—ways—ready—to get—started, jay! Gyueeeen!”

lines.japanese: 「よーし、じゃあ始めるぞー」
lines.english: “All right. Let's begin.”

lines.japanese: 俺は睨みあう両軍代表の前に立って片手をかざした。
lines.english: I stood before the glaring representatives of both armies and raised one hand.

lines.japanese: そして無気力にまっすぐ落とす。
lines.english: Then I let it fall in a perfectly listless chop.

lines.japanese: 「一回戦開始ー……」
lines.english: “Round one, begin...”

lines.japanese: 「ドンドン、パッ！　パ、ドンドンド、パッ！　さっきからうるせえチビスケ、一人じゃ何もできない芋助、クソみてえなパンクやるなら自前でやりな、おまえの能力じゃとっくに限界パンク、空気スカスカ穴だらけ」
lines.english: “Boom-boom, bap! B-boom-boom-boom, bap! Mouthy little punk, helpless little chump. If you're gonna play shit punk, play your own—your talent's hit its limit, punk: tire gone flat, all holes, no air.”

lines.japanese: 「ワンツッスッホッ、黒豚ブヴゥゥゥ！　でかい腹揺らしてブゥゥゥ！　頭もハゲてブゥゥゥ！　ヴヴッヴッブゥゥッゥウるしゃああああっあっあ！　ブビブビ鳴いてる黒ぃ豚あ゛あ゛ああぁぁぁあああああ！！」
lines.english: “One-two, ssh, ho! Black pig, oink-oink! Shake that fat gut, oink-oink! Bald-ass head, oink-oink! Oink-oink-oink, shuuuuut uuuuuuup! Squealing black piiiiiiig!”

lines.japanese: 「所詮借り物、剥けてねえモノ、オナニーだって一人じゃできねえ、そんなにカラスが好きならケツでも差しだしなゲイ野郎、おまえの母ちゃんもビッチだ、掲げるケツにウイスキーで乾杯しやがれ」
lines.english: “All borrowed style, still foreskin-clad, can't even jack it by yourself—how sad. Love that Crow so much? Offer him your ass, you homo. Your mama's a bitch too: raise that rump and toast it with whiskey.”

lines.japanese: 「短小！　短小！　ブタの×ンこは短小！　短小！　ハラに埋もももももれて見えやしねえ゛え゛え×ンコォォオオ！　マ×コにも入らなイヤあ゛あぁぁん気持ちよくなヴぁあ゛あぁ゛ぁ゛ぁあぁぁい゛ッ！！」
lines.english: “Tiny! Tiny! Pig's ×nko's tiny! Tiny! Lost in his gut, buried so deep you can't even see that ×nko! Can't get it in a p×ssy—can't make her feel goo-o-o-ood!”

lines.japanese: 「ヘイＹＯチビクソ、ビチ・グソ・流して・今すぐ・声・あげな！　バカ・面・晒して・まっすぐ・家・逃げな！　弱いやつ追わないこれ俺のルール！　雑魚一人泣かしたらボイン抱いて俺はゴール！」
lines.english: “Hey, yo, little shit! Spill your—runny shit—raise your—voice—right now! Show your—stupid—face—run straight—home—right now! I don't chase the weak, that's my rule! Make one loser cry, grab some tits, and I've reached my goal!”

lines.japanese: 「ズッコン！　バッコン！　ズコバコ（オラァ！）ズコバコ（オラァ！）挿れても挿れてもイケない出せない！　おデブの×ンコは短小×～ンコ～、短小×～ンコ～、短小×～ンコ～・だ・じぇいッ！！」
lines.english: “Thrust in! Pound out! Thrust-and-pound (Ora!) Thrust-and-pound (Ora!) Stick it in and stick it in, still can't come, can't shoot! Fat boy's ×nko is a tiny ×nko, tiny ×nko, tiny ×nko—jay!”

lines.japanese: 「かかってきやがれ、マザファッあぼっ！！」
lines.english: “Bring it, motherfu—ow!”

lines.japanese: 「うぼぉぉぁあああああああぎゃあ！！」
lines.english: “Ubooooooaaaaaagh!”

lines.japanese: 「とっくに持ち点ゼロだおまえら」
lines.english: “You both ran out of points ages ago.”

lines.japanese: 俺は顔が限界まで近づいた二人に、それぞれ鼻フックをお見舞いした。
lines.english: Their faces had closed to point-blank range, so I rewarded each of them with a finger hooked up the nose.

lines.japanese: 「酷ぇぜ成田君よゥ、こっからが一番面白ェとこだってのに」
lines.english: “That's cold, Narita. We were just getting to the best part.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよア～ニキィ！　なんで止めるんだッ！　よォ！」
lines.english: “Yeah, boss! Why’d you stop us? Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「面白いのはおまえらだけだっつうの。見ろ、仲間たちまでドン引きしてんじゃねえか」
lines.english: “Because you're the only ones enjoying it. Look. Even your friends are backing away in disgust.”

lines.japanese: 俺の言葉通り、フレイムバーズとＲ－ウィングの連中は、それぞれ一歩ずつ後退していた。
lines.english: Just as I said, the Flame Birds and the R-Wing men had each retreated one step.

lines.japanese: 「つーわけでおまえら引き分け。ほらどっちも引っこめ」
lines.english: “So it's a draw. Both of you, stand down.”

lines.japanese: 犬でも追い払うようにしっしっとやったが、二人はその場から動かずにお互いを睨みながら不敵な顔で微笑みあった。
lines.english: I shooed them away like dogs, but neither moved. They kept glaring at each other, then traded defiant grins.

lines.japanese: 「フッ、やるじゃねえかパンク小僧。次にやり合う時ぁ容赦しねェが、名前くらいは教えてやるぜ。俺は左右田仙一ａｋａＬＲ２００１だ」
lines.english: “Heh. Not bad, punk. Next time I won't go easy, but I'll give you my name: Senichi Souda, a.k.a. LR2001.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶひゃっひゃひゃひゃっ！　こっちだって次に会ったら、おまえの腹をつかんであげるよォ！　俺、咲夜！　その少ねえ脳みそに叩きこんどけーい！」
lines.english: “Buh-hyah-hyah-hyah! Next time I see you, I'll grab that belly of yours! I'm Sakuya! Hammer it into that pea brain!”

lines.japanese: 「Ｗｏｏ……次に会うときが楽しみだぜ。ちっとは成長しておきなククク」
lines.english: “Woo... Looking forward to next time. Try to grow a little by then. Heh-heh.”

lines.japanese: あまり見たくない組み合わせだった。
lines.english: It was a pairing I could have lived without seeing.

lines.japanese: 「二回戦」
lines.english: “Round two.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、じゃあ次ィー」
lines.english: “Right. Next up.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあここは俺がＬＲの分もビシッと決めちゃおっかねぇー」
lines.english: “Guess I'll make sure this one's settled properly for LR.”

lines.japanese: 「っシャアーッ！　出ました！　出ちゃいました！　『ジャマイカの風』チケドンさんにかかればおまえらなんか殺虫剤かけられたゴキブリと一緒だ、ヴァーカ！　ヴァーッカ！　ぷぷぷ！」
lines.english: “All riiight! Here he is! You're all cockroaches under the bug spray of Chikedon, the Wind of Jamaica! Stuuupid! Stuuuupid! Pff-pff-pff!”

lines.japanese: 「っせェ、ヴァーカ！　ヴァーッカ！　そんならこっちだって『棺の中の詩人』の出番だ、ヒャハ！　狂夜ちゃんの旋律に悶え死ね、ファッキュ！」
lines.english: “Shut it! Stuuupid! Stuuuupid! Then we'll send in the Poet in the Coffin! Writhe yourself to death on Kyoya's melody! Fuck you!”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？　ねえ、どうして傾いた空から僕たちを見下ろそうとするの？　その大地はいくつの咎が重なりあって出来ているというの？」
lines.english: “Why? Tell me, why do you look down upon us from a sky tilted askew? How many sins lie one upon another to compose the earth beneath your feet?”

lines.japanese: 「あのさ、念のために聞くけどさ。咲夜、おまえはこの女の言ってること理解出来てるんだよね？」
lines.english: “Just checking, Sakuya. You do understand what this woman is saying, right?”

lines.japanese: 「ぶぁッ、わかるに決ま、きま、きまきまキマ、ヴァヴぁヴぁヴぁヴぁヴぁああああーっ！！」
lines.english: “Bwah! Course I un-under-understand! I'm locked, locked, locked in, high-high-high-high-hiiiiiiigh!”

lines.japanese: 「ごまかすな、勢いでごまかすな。とりあえず叫んでおけば見逃してもらえると思うなよ」
lines.english: “Don't bluff. Don't try to bulldoze past it with momentum. Screaming won't make me let it slide.”

lines.japanese: 「なにがキマってるってえ？　そこのおネエちゃんもさあ、なんか苦しそうじゃん、だったら一服いっとく？　イヤ～なことまとめて全部ポンしちゃうよ？」
lines.english: “What's locked in—and high—huh? The chick over there looks like she's hurting. Want a smoke? One puff and all the bad stuff goes poof.”

lines.japanese: おお、意外と友好的だ。フレイムバーズのドレッドは手巻きタバコを箱から一本取りだすと、電波女にそれを勧めた。
lines.english: Oh. Unexpectedly friendly. The Flame Bird with the dreadlocks drew a hand-rolled cigarette from its box and offered it to the space cadet.

lines.japanese: 「脳を溶かしながら戯れることに意味はあるの？」
lines.english: “Is there meaning in playing while your brain dissolves?”
“Haaah?!”

lines.japanese: だけど大方の予想通りそこに友情は生まれなかった。ていうかたった一言で険悪な空気が広がった。
lines.english: But, just as anyone could have predicted, no friendship blossomed between them. In fact, a single sentence was enough to sour the air.

lines.japanese: 「え、ええ、今なんつった？　おまえさァ！　そういう間違った偏見がイメージ悪くすんのよ、カンベンしてよもォ！」
lines.english: “W-wait, what'd you just say? It's ignorant prejudice like that that gives it a bad name! Come on, seriously!”

lines.japanese: 「知らないのは君、そしてそこでくすぶっている小鳥たち。いま僕に映るイメージは断頭台に乗せられた養鶏、惨々たる畜殺の光景だよ」
lines.english: “You are the one who does not know. You, and the little birds smoldering over there. What I see now is a flock laid upon the guillotine—a panorama of hideous slaughter.”

lines.japanese: 「ただ、君たちが、それでもひとでありたいと願うのなら、自らガス室の扉を開くのが贖罪の道。それが出来るならいい子だねと頭を撫でてあげる」
lines.english: “But if you still wish to be human, then open the gas-chamber door yourselves. That is your road to atonement. Do that, and I will stroke your heads and call you good children.”

lines.japanese: 「でしょォ！？　な～によ、分かってんじゃん、そうそう煙に包まれればみんな幸せになれんのよォ！　いや～、なんだよ話せば分かるやつもいるんじゃない、ハ～イそれじゃ、じょいんと・プリ～ズ？」
lines.english: “Right?! See, you do get it! Exactly—once the smoke wraps around you, everybody gets to be happy! Hey, look at that. Guess some people understand if you just talk to 'em. All right, then: joint, please?”

lines.japanese: ドレッドが電波女に再び手巻きタバコを差しだした。俺は電波女が受けとる前に、有無を言わさずやつの手元にそれを押しかえした。
lines.english: Dreadlocks offered the hand-rolled cigarette to the space cadet again. Before she could accept it, I shoved it straight back at him, giving him no say in the matter.

lines.japanese: 「なに！　なんで邪魔すんの成田チャン、あんた俺の仲間じゃない！」
lines.english: “What! Narita, why're you getting in my way? Ain't you my friend?”

lines.japanese: 「おい、この流れで物騒なこと言うな。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Don't say anything incriminating in the middle of this. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよもォ、みんなしてェ！　じゃあ俺がどんだけいいモンか見せてあげるよ！　ちょっと待っててねぇ！」
lines.english: “Aw, come on, everybody! Fine, I'll show you how great this stuff is! Just watch!”

lines.japanese: 「すぱーっ……」
lines.english: “Fffffh...”

lines.japanese: 「ねェ～？　分かったでしょォ？」
lines.english: “See? Now you get it, right?”

lines.japanese: 「分からない。今すぐ捨てろ、そのタバコ的なものを」
lines.english: “No. Throw that cigarette-like object away immediately.”

lines.japanese: 俺はフレイムバーズの連中に、目の前の男を速やかに退場させるよう命じた。
lines.english: I ordered the Flame Birds to drag the man away at once.

lines.japanese: 「なにすんじゃあッッ！」
lines.english: “The hell're you doin'?!”

lines.japanese: しかしドレッド男の腕力は強く、腕をつかんだ二名が地面に叩きつけられた。意外とパワフルだ。
lines.english: But the dreadlocked man proved surprisingly strong, slamming both men who seized his arms to the ground.

lines.japanese: 「お、おまえら俺を拉致ろうたって、どど、どこ行くの？　海越えるならおまえそんな、空まではムリだろ？」
lines.english: “Y-you guys think you can abduct me? Wh-wh-where're we going? If we're crossing the ocean, then, y'know, you can't make it all the way to the sky, can you?”

lines.japanese: 「それは窓を見上げることしか出来ない数字たちの限界。僕たちには、主の聖痕の中に楽園への地図が見えるの。目で見るのじゃなくて心に染みこませるの」
lines.english: “That is the limit of numbers capable only of gazing up at a window. Within the wounds of our Lord, we see a map to paradise. Do not look upon it with your eyes. Let it seep into your heart.”

lines.japanese: 「そうよ～、目に見えるもんなんか、な～んも信用できんのんよ～？　ぶひゃひゃ、楽園ならこ、ここにあンのよォ～、それが見えないひとたちは可哀想だなあ！」
lines.english: “Right! You can't trust a single thing your eyes show you! Buh-hyah-hyah! Paradise is right here, riiight here! Feel sorry for everybody who can't see it!”

lines.japanese: 「可哀想なのはおまえだよ」
lines.english: “You're the one I feel sorry for.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、君には見えるの楽園が。いい子だね」
lines.english: “Yes. You can see paradise. What a good boy.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、そこも理解示すな。微妙に会話が成立してるっぽい」
lines.english: “No, don't validate him either. Somehow you're almost managing a conversation.”

lines.japanese: 「だだ、大体ね、聞きなさいよ。おまえらが唱えるその健康？　安全？　そんなもん誰に作られてんのかって？　ほら考えたこともないでしょお、そっからして間違っててて、てるのよおまえらはさぁ！」
lines.english: “L-listen, for one thing. That health and safety you people worship—who do you think invented them, huh? Never even thought about it, did you? That's where you're wrong from the ground up!”

lines.japanese: 「檻の中の豚がその存在に疑問を持つとでもいうの？　面白いね、フフフ」
lines.english: “Do you imagine a pig in its cage ever questions its existence? How amusing. Hee-hee.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、何が面白いのかさっぱりだ」
lines.english: “I have no idea which part of that was amusing.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、じゃあ成田っちにも分かるように説明……あ、あ、おなか空かない？　俺なんか肉的なもの食べたい気分なんよ。あと甘いもの食べたいよねえ、なんかいい店この辺なかったっけなあ～」
lines.english: “Then, then I'll explain so even Narita can—hey, anybody hungry? I feel like eating something meat-ish. Something sweet, too. Wasn't there a good place around here?”

lines.japanese: 「お～い、誰か天丼買ってきてちょ。ぎゃははは、天丼って肉じゃねえよ！　あ、海老天でよろしくね！　成田っちも一杯いっとく～？」
lines.english: “Hey, somebody go buy me a tempura bowl. Gyah-hah-hah! That's not meat! Make mine shrimp tempura! Narita, want one too?”

lines.japanese: 「もうおまえ、好き勝手っていうか、どんだけフリーダムなんだよ」
lines.english: “You don't just do whatever you want. You are freedom itself.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、なんかだるくなってきた。そうだ、立ってるのも結構なエネルギーを消費して、その分地球から失われていくんだもんね。その結果、宇宙全体のバランスが……」
lines.english: “Ahh, I'm getting tired. Of course. Just standing consumes a considerable amount of energy, and that much energy disappears from the earth. As a result, the balance of the entire universe...”

lines.japanese: 「もういいや。俺、寝ます」
lines.english: “Never mind. I'm going to sleep.”

lines.japanese: ドレッド頭は近くのベンチまで行くと、ごろんと横たわって大きな寝息を立てはじめた。
lines.english: Dreadlocks walked over to a nearby bench, flopped onto it, and promptly began snoring.

lines.japanese: 「そのまま永久に寝てしまえ」
lines.english: “Keep sleeping forever.”

lines.japanese: 「三回戦」
lines.english: “Round three.”

lines.japanese: 「なんかもうグダグダになってきたけど、はい次ぃ」
lines.english: “This whole thing's coming apart at the seams, but fine. Next.”

lines.japanese: 「うっす！　隼人先輩、自分なんスけど、ちょっと今回マジギレなんでえ！　ちっと言葉とかガンガン過ぎちゃうかもしんないスけど、自分ほんと裏切りとか許せねーんスよ！」
lines.english: “Hayato! I'm seriously pissed this time! My language might get kinda intense, but I really can't forgive betrayal!”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　それはちょっとおかしくない？　僕たちが裏切ったっていうのは、君たちが勝手に言ってるだけだよね？」
lines.english: “Hm? Isn't that a little strange? You people are the only ones claiming we betrayed you.”

lines.japanese: 「はいぃ～？　だっておまえら降伏するとかゆってぇー、俺らに白旗あげたじゃん。しかも俺ら許してやってんのに噛みつくとか、そういうのおかしくね？　なあこれ間違ってね？」
lines.english: “Huuuh? You said you surrendered. You waved the white flag at us. Then after we let you off, you came back biting. Ain't that messed up? Tell me I'm wrong.”

lines.japanese: 「ふっ、君さあ、そうやって凄めばみんなが引いてくれたんだろうけど、その辺りからして間違ってるんだよね」
lines.english: “Heh. I suppose glaring like that has always made everyone back down. But that's where your mistakes begin.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　ちょ、イミわかんね、説明してくんね？」
lines.english: “Huh? I don't get you. Wanna explain?”

lines.japanese: 「だってさあ、現在、君たち柳木原フレイムバーズの頭は誰なんだい？」
lines.english: “Who is the current head of your Yanagihara Flame Birds?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「頭……ってーとカケルさんじゃね？」
lines.english: “The head... You mean Kakeru, right?”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、その鳳翔はどこにいるんだい？　僕たちは引退したって聞いてるよ」
lines.english: “Really? And where is Kakeru Otori now? We heard he retired.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ隼人先輩でしょ！」
lines.english: “Then it's Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 「断じて違う」
lines.english: “Absolutely not.”

lines.japanese: 「ホラ見なよ、胴体だけじゃ体は動けないでしょ？　頭のいない君たちはフレイムバーズじゃなくて烏合の衆ってことなんだよ」
lines.english: “There, you see? A body can't move without its head. Without a head, you aren't Flame Birds at all—just a flock of crows. A rabble.”

lines.japanese: 「隼人先輩、ウゴウノシューってなんすか」
lines.english: “Hayato, what's a rabble?”

lines.japanese: 「寄せ集めみたいなカンジ」
lines.english: “Like a bunch of random people thrown together.”

lines.japanese: 「まあそれは否定しねーけどお。でもさあ、俺らがフレイムバーズってことに変わりはなくね？　そうでしょ？」
lines.english: “Well, I ain't denying that. But we're still the Flame Birds, right? Ain't we?”

lines.japanese: 「ふふ、分かってないね、君たちが言うフレイムバーズっていうのは、鳳翔がいたからこそ成りたってたんだよ。そもそも僕たちが降伏したのも、彼がいたからこそ、でしょ？」
lines.english: “Hee-hee. You don't understand. Those Flame Birds you speak of existed only because Kakeru Otori was there. We surrendered in the first place precisely because he was there, didn't we?”

lines.japanese: 「だとしてもぉ、翔さんが居なくなった瞬間手のひら返すとか、カッコ悪いんじゃないスかねえ！」
lines.english: “Even if that's true, changing your tune the second Kakeru disappears is pretty damn lame, don't you think?”

lines.japanese: 「どうしてだい？　偉大なる王の引退後に政権が変わった例はいくらでもあるじゃないか。君たちがかっこ悪いことをしたら、それに反対する僕たちはかっこいいってことになるんじゃないかなあ、んふふ」
lines.english: “Why? History is full of regimes changing after a great king retires. If what you do is disgraceful, then opposing you makes us admirable, doesn't it? Nhee-hee.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なにいってんのおまえ」
lines.english: “Huh? What the hell're you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「つまり僕たちが反逆の謗りを受ける謂れはないってことだよ」
lines.english: “It means there are no grounds for branding us traitors.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ちゅうかー、おまえらにも頭っていなくね？」
lines.english: “Oh, wait. Don't you guys have no leader either?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、元々猊下は僕たちの頭ってわけじゃないんだ。ただガード下の時はたまたま最年長の彼が指揮をとっただけで……まあその辺は僕たちのミスだね、うふっ」
lines.english: “Oh, His Holiness was never exactly our leader. During that business under the overpass, he merely happened to be the eldest and took command... I suppose that was our mistake. Tee-hee.”

lines.japanese: 「いや猊下って誰よ？」
lines.english: “Who the hell is His Holiness?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、それは君たちは知らなくてもいいことだよ、ふっ」
lines.english: “Oh, you don't need to know that. Heh.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そ～なんだあ。ぎゃはははは」
lines.english: “Oh, that right? Gyah-hah-hah-hah!”

lines.japanese: 「セイィィッ！」
lines.english: “Seeei!”

lines.japanese: 「ごふっ！」
lines.english: “Guh!”

lines.japanese: 「て、手は出さないって言ったじゃん……」
lines.english: “Y-you said we wouldn't use our hands...”

lines.japanese: 「いやー、すんません隼人先輩、自分やっぱ武士道の血が流れてるんでー、やっちゃいました。てぃひ！」
lines.english: “Sorry, Hayato. Guess I've got the warrior spirit in my blood after all. Couldn't help myself. Tee-hee!”

lines.japanese: 「俺もすっきりしちゃいました。てぃひっ」
lines.english: “I feel better too. Tee-hee.”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんで……ごふっ」
lines.english: “Wh-why... Guh.”

lines.japanese: 「ギャル男は試合に負けて勝負に勝った……それだけのことさ」
lines.english: “The party boy lost the match but won the fight... That's all there is to it.”

lines.japanese: 「押忍ッ！」
lines.english: “Yes, sir!”

lines.japanese: 「うう、酷いよ成田クン……」
lines.english: “Ooh... That's cruel, Narita...”

lines.japanese: それにしても誰ひとり心配しないあたり、Ｒ－ウィング内にも友達いないのかこいつ。
lines.english: Come to think of it, nobody showed the slightest concern for him. Did this guy not have a single friend inside R-Wing either?

lines.japanese: 「四回戦」
lines.english: “Round four.”

lines.japanese: 「で、一人戦闘不能に陥ってベンチで寝てるし、気は済んだ？　もういいよね？　俺、帰るよ？」
lines.english: “One man is down and another's asleep on a bench. You people satisfied yet? We're done, right? I can go home?”

lines.japanese: 「ぶはははアニキィ、そりゃこれまでの戦績からゆってえ、俺らの勝ちってことでいいぃぃぃ゛ぃぃ゛んなああああーっ！？」
lines.english: “Buh-hah-hah, Big Bro! Going by the score so far, we’ve won, r-r-r-right?!”

lines.japanese: 「シット！　なに勝手なこと言ってやがんだ、ファッキン・ＵＫメン！　まぁだ勝負は終わっちゃいねえだろ、Ｅｈ？」
lines.english: “Shit! Who the fuck decided that, you fucking UK man? This battle ain't over yet, eh?”

lines.japanese: 「うひっひひひっ、まあ豚クンが恥かきたいなら、い、いい、いいけどォ～！？　ま、まだ、まだ誰かいんののののばばばばあ゛ああァ～ッ！」
lines.english: “Uh-heh-heh! If Piggy wants to embarrass himself some more, f-f-fine by me! You g-g-got anybody left?”

lines.japanese: 「ア～イ？　ちゅっても、俺もまだアタマ冴えてきてないしネ～、次は誰いく～？」
lines.english: “Aye? I mean, my head still ain't clear yet. Who's next?”

lines.japanese: 「そーだ！　じゃあキモくてモテなさそーなあいつらに、女の視点から言ってやって！」
lines.english: “Oh, I know! Give these creepy losers who'll never get a girl the woman's-eye view!”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　フレイムバーズに女子部ってあったっけ……」
lines.english: “Hm? I didn't know the Flame Birds had a women's division...”

lines.japanese: 「えー、てゆか私カンケーないもん」
lines.english: “What? This has nothing to do with me.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: なんだ、香田も居たんだ。
lines.english: Oh. Koda was here too.

lines.japanese: 「はれっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「ウソ、あーっ！　隼人君じゃーん！」
lines.english: “No way—ah! Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 「うっす」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、佐久間君も久しぶりー！」
lines.english: “Oh, Sakuma! Long time no see!”

lines.japanese: 「あルェ～ッ！？　コンバンハーって、胸パットの彼女サン、やっぱニワトリさんたちのお仲間だったのォ？　ガルッ！」
lines.english: “Whuh-whaaat?! Good evening! So the girlfriend with the padded bra really was one of the little chickens? Grr!”

lines.japanese: 「うっさい！　彼女の前の一言いらん！」
lines.english: “Shut up! Leave out the part before ‘girlfriend’!”

lines.japanese: 「え？　彼女の部分がいらなくね？」
lines.english: “Huh? Surely ‘girlfriend’ is the part you should leave out.”

lines.japanese: 「それからフレイムバーズには入ってないから。私、隼人君と同じ一般市民チームだもん」
lines.english: “And I'm not a Flame Bird. I'm on the ordinary-citizens team, same as Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「てゆか隼人チームだもん、ねーっ？」
lines.english: “Actually, I'm on Team Hayato. Right?”

lines.japanese: 「隼人チーム」
lines.english: “Team Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 中々いい響きだ。チーム羽田だったら尚よかったけど、ここは事情的にやむを得ない。それで妥協しよう。
lines.english: It had a fine ring to it. Team Haneda would have been better still, but circumstances made that impossible. I could compromise.

lines.japanese: すんな、妥協すんな、と脳内で五分の一が喚いているけどそんなものは知ったことじゃない。もちろん無視だ。
lines.english: Don't. Do not compromise, shouted the one fifth inside my head. As if I cared. Naturally, I ignored him.

lines.japanese: 「なんだよォ、じゃあ彼女サンも俺たちの敵ってわけじゃないじゃーん」
lines.english: “What? Then the girlfriend ain't our enemy either!”

lines.japanese: 「彼女ッ！？」
lines.english: “Girlfriend?!”

lines.japanese: 俺よりも先に返事をした連中がいた。
lines.english: Several men answered before I could.

lines.japanese: 「なんだよコーダイン、おまえいつの間に成田クンに女豹にされちまったんだ、Ｈｕｈ！」
lines.english: “What the hell, Kodine? When did Narita turn you into his she-leopard, huh?”

lines.japanese: 「してねえよ」
lines.english: “I didn't.”

lines.japanese: 「まーったく成田っちは油断も隙もないよねー。見た目には全然変わらないから気づかなかったよ～？」
lines.english: “Honestly, Narita, there's no letting your guard down around you. You don't look any different, so I never noticed!”

lines.japanese: 「見たまんまだよ」
lines.english: “That's because nothing happened.”

lines.japanese: 「さっすが隼人先輩！　俺らが見てないところで、やることしっかりやってんわ！　伊達にフレイムバーズの二代目継いでねえわ」
lines.english: “That's our Hayato! Taking care of business where we can't see him! You didn't inherit the Flame Birds as second boss for nothing!”

lines.japanese: 「継いでねえよ」
lines.english: “I didn't.”

lines.japanese: この分だと一々説明するのも面倒くさそうだ。どうせ香田が後から誤解をといてくれるだろうから、放っておくことにしよう。
lines.english: Explaining every little thing looked exhausting. Koda would clear up the misunderstanding later, so I decided to leave it alone.

lines.japanese: 「い～や、おかしいと思ったんだよねェ！　雄鶏しかいないニワトリの中から雌鳥が出てきたと思ったらアニキの彼女サンでさあ！　モテないニワトリどもの中に雌鳥がいるわけないもんねえ！」
lines.english: “I knew something was funny! A hen comes walking out of a flock with nothing but roosters, and it turns out she's Brother's girlfriend! Course there ain't no hens among a bunch of dateless chickens!”

lines.japanese: 「も、もて、モテねえだと！？　ふ、ふざけんな、彼女くらい、いる、いるかもしれないだろッ！」
lines.english: “D-d-dateless?! D-don't screw with us! We might have girlfriends! Possibly!”

lines.japanese: しかし、そんなフレイムバーズの連中のことを、何故か佐久間は高い位置から一瞥して、鼻をふんと鳴らした。
lines.english: Yet Sakuma looked down at the Flame Birds from his lofty perch for some reason and gave a scornful sniff.

lines.japanese: 「まぁ～、あんたらと違ってェ、違ってェ？　俺らァ、チーム内に女の子だっているからねェ、ぬははは！」
lines.english: “W-well, unlike you losers, we've even got girls on our team! Nuh-hah-hah!”

lines.japanese: 「でも佐久間君はキモイ」
lines.english: “But you're still creepy, Sakuma.”

lines.japanese: 「ヴウェッ！？　くはぁ！　こりゃキッツイわぁ、さっすがアニキの彼女サンだぁ～ん、だあん、だだあーん！」
lines.english: “Bweh?! Kha! That cuts deep. As expected of Brother's girlfriend! Dun-dun, da-da-dun!”

lines.japanese: 「おお！　なんだか知んねーけど、コーダインがダメージ与えてんじゃん！　おし、きたきたぁ！」
lines.english: “Oh! Dunno what just happened, but Kodine did damage! Yeah, now we're talking!”

lines.japanese: 「く、くそうっ！　アニキの彼女サンじゃ言いかえせないジャン、ジャンジャンジャン！　こうなったらこっちも、秘密兵器いいい゛いいい゛ぃぃ゛ぃぃ゛ーっ！」
lines.english: “D-damn it! I can't talk back to Brother's girlfriend! In that case, we'll deploy our secret weapooooon!”

lines.japanese: 「俺らの、中、にも、かわいい、子、なら、いる、んだ、じぇいっ！　ファッキュ！」
lines.english: “We've got a cute girl on our side too, jay! Fuck you!”

lines.japanese: 「瑠樺ちゃーん、ちょこっと、い、い゛いい゛いいっかなーん！？」
lines.english: “Ruka! Could you come here for j-just a second?!”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　はね……」
lines.english: “Wait, Hane—”

lines.japanese: <8>\「おわあああっ！」
lines.english: “Waaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 俺は山科に飛びかかって、開きかけたその口を押さえこんだ。
lines.english: I threw myself at Yamashina and clamped a hand over her half-open mouth.

lines.japanese: そういえば昼休みに山科がＲ－ウィングの話をしていた気がする。まさかほんとに来るとは思わなかった……迂闊だ。その口から羽田の名前が出る前に、なんとか言いきかせなければ。
lines.english: Come to think of it, Yamashina had mentioned R-Wing at lunch. I never imagined she would actually come... Careless. I had to explain before the name Haneda escaped her lips.

lines.japanese: 「いいか、山科。俺はここで破壊の破に闇夜の夜、使徒の徒でＨＮ破夜徒で通ってる」
lines.english: “Listen, Yamashina. Around here my handle is Hayato—written with the ha for destruction, the ya for night, and the to for apostle.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、そうなの？　タカシくんじゃ……ないんだ」
lines.english: “Oh, really? So you're not... Takashi?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、何個かあるんだ。だからここでは隼人と呼んでくれ、頼む」
lines.english: “I've got several names. Please call me Hayato here. I'm begging you.”

lines.japanese: 「へー……うん、いいけど、じゃあ私も瑠樺でいいかな」
lines.english: “Oh... Sure. Then is it all right if I'm Ruka here too?”

lines.japanese: 「もちろんだ、ありがとう瑠樺サン」
lines.english: “Of course. Thank you, Miss Ruka.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なにちょっと、知り合いなーん？」
lines.english: “Hey, wait. You two know each other?”

lines.japanese: 山科とひそひそ話をしていたら香田が割りこんできた。不服そうな声。
lines.english: Koda cut in while Yamashina and I whispered together. She sounded displeased.

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　ああ、まあそんなカンジ。お友達の瑠樺サンだ、以後シクヨロ」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh, sort of. This is my friend Miss Ruka. Be nice to each other.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、隼人君、こっち系も好きなんだあ」
lines.english: “Ohhh. So Hayato likes this type too.”

lines.japanese: なにか誤解があるみたいだが、これも面倒だからそのままにしておこう。
lines.english: She appeared to be laboring under a misconception, but correcting it sounded like trouble, so I let that one stand too.

lines.japanese: 「瑠樺ちゃん、こいつら、ギタギタに、しちゃえようッ！　得意の作詞で、こいつらのチキンハートを木っ端微塵にしちゃえ、よう！　ファッキュ！」
lines.english: “Ruka, t-tear these losers to shreds! Use those lyrics of yours to smash their chicken hearts into pieces! Fuck you!”

lines.japanese: 「笑顔で心臓に釘を打てる君には爪の間に針を二度刺しこむ痛みを教えたい」
lines.english: “To you, who can hammer nails through a heart with a smile, I wish to teach the pain of needles driven twice beneath each fingernail.”

lines.japanese: 「すっ、すみませんでしたぁ……！」
lines.english: “I-I'm very sorry...!”

lines.japanese: 「で、私なんで呼ばれたん？　隼人君判定人なんでしょ、早く判定してよ」
lines.english: “So why'd you call me over? Hayato's the judge, right? Hurry up and judge us.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「私と瑠樺さん？　どっちか選ぶんでしょ」
lines.english: “Me or Ruka? You're supposed to choose one, right?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　いつの間にそういうことになってんの？　つかおまえ、その言い方だとなんかニュアンス違くね？」
lines.english: “What? When did that become the question? And don't you think the way you put it gives this a whole different implication?”

lines.japanese: ちらりと横目。俺はがしがしと後ろ頭を掻いて苦い顔をした。
lines.english: She glanced sideways. I scratched vigorously at the back of my head and grimaced.

lines.japanese: 「♪胸パット～胸パット～！」
lines.english: “♪ Padded bra, padded bra!”

lines.japanese: その横では佐久間が歌を口ずさんでいた。
lines.english: Beside us, Sakuma had started humming.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ瑠樺ちゃんの勝ちってことで」
lines.english: “Then Ruka wins.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょーっ！　なんで！？　いまなにを基準に判定したっ？」
lines.english: “Whaaat! Why?! What standard did you just use?!”

lines.japanese: 「コーダインこいつは仕方ねえ……俺たちの負けだ」
lines.english: “Kodine, it can't be helped... We lost this one.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！？　ＬＲさん味方じゃないの！　てゆかなんで！　理由！　理由教えてよ！」
lines.english: “What?! LR, aren't you on my side? And why? Tell me why!”

lines.japanese: 「そんな残酷なこと言えないよ」
lines.english: “I couldn't say anything that cruel.”

lines.japanese: 「いいよ、ゆってよ。なにもったいぶってんの」
lines.english: “Just say it. Why're you being all dramatic?”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ言うけどむね」
lines.english: “Fine. Your chest.”

lines.japanese: 「なあーっ！　ソレ関係なくない！？」
lines.english: “Whaaat! That has nothing to do with it!”

lines.japanese: 「さあ、子供は帰る時間だよ。早く家にお戻り」
lines.english: “Come along. It's time for children to go home. Run along now.”

lines.japanese: 「頼まれたっていてやらんし！　へん、亜衣ぽん帰して寂しい夜でも過ごしてろバーカ、バーカ！」
lines.english: “I wouldn't stay if you begged me! Fine! Send Ai-pon home and spend a lonely night, stupid! Stupid!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあ私も、遅くなるとおばあちゃん心配するから帰るね」
lines.english: “Oh, then I should go too. Grandma will worry if I'm late.”

lines.japanese: 「今日はストリートライブもやらないみたいだし。またね、バイバイ」
lines.english: “And it doesn't look like there'll be a street gig tonight. See you. Bye-bye.”

lines.japanese: 「ふっ、今回は完敗だ……だが、次はこうはいかねェゼ！」
lines.english: “Heh. A crushing defeat this time... But next time will be different!”

lines.japanese: 「完敗ってゆーなあ！」
lines.english: “Don't call it a crushing defeat!”

lines.japanese: 「まだいたんだ」
lines.english: “You were still here?”

lines.japanese: 「五回戦」
lines.english: “Round five.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、もうなんかどーでもいいような気もするけど、まだやるの？」
lines.english: “Sigh. I'm starting not to care anymore, but you're still doing this?”

lines.japanese: 「くっ、このままじゃヤバイぜ。やつら好き勝手しやがって……」
lines.english: “Damn. This is bad. They're doing whatever they please...”

lines.japanese: 「クソッ、こんなときに、あのひとさえいれば！」
lines.english: “Shit. If only that man were here at a time like this!”

lines.japanese: 「へっ、どうしたニワトリさんたちよ？　泣いて頭下げるなら許してやってもいいぜェ？」
lines.english: “What's wrong, little chickens? If you cry and bow your heads, we might forgive you.”

lines.japanese: 「ちっくしょう！　このままじゃ俺たちの負けか！」
lines.english: “Damn it! Are we really gonna lose like this?!”

lines.japanese: 「さあて、そんじゃトドメといきますかぁ……」
lines.english: “All right. Time to finish you off...”

lines.japanese: 「おおっとそこまでだァ！」
lines.english: “Hold it right there!”

lines.japanese: 「なッ、なんだ！？」
lines.english: “Wh-what?!”

lines.japanese: 「お、おまえはっ！」
lines.english: “Y-you!”
“It's me!”

lines.japanese: 「闇を切り裂く白銀の翼、蹄を鳴らして空を駆け、味方のピンチにただいま参上！　ＹＦＢ期待のホープ、炎のチャレンジャー森里和馬とは俺のことだああっ！　そりゃっ！　フェニックスのポーズ！」
lines.english: “Silver wings cleaving the dark! Hooves ringing as they gallop through the sky! Here to save his friends in their hour of need! The YFB's rising hope, the challenger of flame—Kazuma Morisato! Hyaaah! Phoenix pose!”

lines.japanese: フレイムバーズの後方から森里君が現れた。
lines.english: Morisato appeared behind the Flame Birds.

lines.japanese: 「……ああ、あれ、退院したの」
lines.english: “...Oh. Hey. You got out of the hospital?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　あいや、まだだけど、みんなのピンチに駆けつけようと思って……」
lines.english: “Huh? Uh, no, not yet. But I thought I'd rush over because everybody was in trouble...”

lines.japanese: 「あー……ああ、そうなん」
lines.english: “Oh... Oh, right.”

lines.japanese: 「あー……じゃあ、まあ、座ればその辺……」
lines.english: “Uh... Well, you can sit somewhere over there, I guess.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、ありがと……」
lines.english: “O-oh. Thanks...”

lines.japanese: しかし後方からの登場だったため、Ｒ－ウィングには気づかれないまま森里君の出番は終わった。
lines.english: But because he had entered from his own side's rear, R-Wing never even noticed him, and Morisato's moment was over.

lines.japanese: それから幾つかの応酬があったものの、戦況は互角だった。
lines.english: Several more exchanges followed, but the battle remained evenly matched.

lines.japanese: いや、わずかにＲ－ウイングの方がフレイムバーズを押していた。何故なら、どちらかが勝たないといつまでも帰れないと踏んだ俺が、やつら贔屓の判定を下したからだ。
lines.english: No—R-Wing held a narrow advantage over the Flame Birds. I had realized I would never get to leave unless somebody won, so I was judging in their favor.

lines.japanese: 「ぶひゃひゃひゃもうネタギレかなニワトリのみんなぁ？　かなかなぁ？」
lines.english: “Buh-hyah-hyah! Run out of material, little chickens? Have you, have you?”

lines.japanese: 「ダムッ！　あいつら調子に乗りやがって……！」
lines.english: “Damn! Those bastards are getting cocky...!”

lines.japanese: 「でもこのままじゃ確かにマズイよネ～、もうこっちから出すやつってーと、成田っちしか残ってないよ」
lines.english: “Yeah, we really are in trouble at this rate. Narita's the only guy left we can send out.”

lines.japanese: 「成田っちは最初から選択肢にないよ」
lines.english: “Narita was never an option.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふん、所詮は知能の足りないニワトリさんたちだ。三歩でものを忘れる連中に、僕たちが頭脳戦で負けるわけないよねえ、フフフ」
lines.english: “Hmph. Chickens of inferior intellect, one and all. How could we ever lose a battle of wits to creatures that forget everything in three steps? Hee-hee-hee.”

lines.japanese: 「飛べない羽根の家畜たち。敗北を知ったなら二度と鶏舎から踏みだそうと思わないで」
lines.english: “Domesticated birds with flightless wings. Now that you know defeat, never think to step outside your coop again.”

lines.japanese: 「うしゃしゃしゃ！　ほらほらぁもう帰っちゃいなよォ！　もうすぐ朝でしょォ？　朝になったら鳴くのがあんたらの仕事でしょォ？　二度と夜中にコケコッコ鳴かないでよ、ぶしゃしゃしゃ！」
lines.english: “Ushah-shah-shah! Come on, run home! Morning's almost here, isn't it? Crowing at dawn is your job, right? Don't ever go cock-a-doodle-doo in the middle of the night again! Buh-shah-shah-shah!”

lines.japanese: 今まで屈辱に耐えてきたＲ－ウイングが、ゾンビ映画よろしく黒い壁となって一歩ずつ近づいてくる。
lines.english: R-Wing, having endured humiliation until now, advanced one step at a time like a black wall from a zombie movie.

lines.japanese: 「くっそう！　好き勝手言いやがって！　こんな時に皇帝さえいてくれたら……っ！」
lines.english: “Damn it! They’re running their mouths like they own the place! If only the Emperor were here...!”

lines.japanese: 「カケルゥ？　最近見ない汲み取りカケルゥ！　どっか田舎で肥え桶かついで田んぼでも耕してんのんのんのんのんのォ！？　そんなやつ来ても関係な、なな、なぶはあ゛あ゛ぁぁーぁ゛ーああー！」
lines.english: “Kakeru? That sewage-scooping Kakeru nobody's seen lately? Is he off in the sticks carrying a honey bucket and plowing the paddies? Wouldn't matter if that loser came anywa-wa-waaaaaagh!”

lines.japanese: 「無駄な足掻きはやめて大人しく泣きいれなよ。さあーそれじゃトドメといきますかぁ」
lines.english: “Stop struggling and surrender quietly. All right, time to finish this.”

lines.japanese: 「クッ、きやがった……！」
lines.english: “Damn. Here it comes...!”

lines.japanese: ヤバいマズいとフレイムバーズに混乱が走る。いよいよＲ－ウイングの侵攻は、対峙する両軍の中間地点たる俺を越えようとしていた──
lines.english: Panic rippled through the Flame Birds. R-Wing's advance was finally about to cross me, the midpoint between the opposing armies—

lines.japanese: 「フゥゥウゥ……」
lines.english: “Hhhhhhh...”

lines.japanese: ──まさにそのときだった。
lines.english: —and that was the exact moment it happened.

lines.japanese: 「話は……聞かせてもらったぜ……」
lines.english: “I have... heard everything...”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんだっ？」
lines.english: “Wh-what?!”

lines.japanese: 声がした。スモークの夜に馴染む、吐息混じりのかすれ声。
lines.english: A voice spoke. A breathy rasp that blended into the smoke-hazed night.

lines.japanese: 頭上を走りゆく通勤電車がけたたましい轟音を巻きおこしている。だが何故かその声は、冬の大気にいやらしく粘ついて群衆の耳まで届いた。
lines.english: A commuter train roared overhead in a deafening tumult. Yet somehow the voice clung obscenely to the winter air and reached every ear in the crowd.

lines.japanese: 「俺を……待ったかおまえたち……」
lines.english: “Have you... been waiting for me...?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あれはっ！」
lines.english: “Th-that's—!”

lines.japanese: フレイムバーズが橋梁の上を指差した。男が立っていた。計ったように迫ってくる上り列車の前照灯が、男の背後からその陰影をくっきりと浮き彫りにした。
lines.english: A Flame Bird pointed up at the bridge. A man stood there. The headlights of an approaching train, timed as if by design, carved his silhouette sharply out of the darkness.

lines.japanese: 逆行を背負った影が、地上の民衆に応えて、翼のような両腕を悠然と広げる。
lines.english: The backlit shadow answered the people below by spreading both arms with the stately sweep of wings.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！」
lines.english: “Hah!”

lines.japanese: 全身を包むようなロングコートにたっぷり風を含ませて、天から怪鳥が舞いおりてきた。Ｒ－ウィングに戦慄のような動揺が走る。
lines.english: His long coat swelling with wind until it seemed to envelop him, the monstrous bird descended from heaven. A shudder passed through R-Wing.

lines.japanese: 「お、おまえはっ……」
lines.english: “Y-you're...”

lines.japanese: 「おまえは“灼熱の猛禽”フェニックス・フレアゴールド！」
lines.english: “You're the Scorching Raptor—Phoenix Flaregold!”

lines.japanese: 俺の中の誰かが熱血少年漫画風のノリに乗っかりやがった。
lines.english: Somebody inside me had gotten swept up in the fever pitch of a boys' action comic.

lines.japanese: 「フハハハ！　おまえらの大好きな俺様が帰ってきたぜえ！」
lines.english: “Fwah-hah-hah! The man you all adore has returned!”

lines.japanese: 「皇帝！」
lines.english: “The Emperor!”

lines.japanese: 「皇帝だ！」
lines.english: “It's the Emperor!”

lines.japanese: 「皇帝が来てくれたぁ！」
lines.english: “The Emperor came for us!”

lines.japanese: 偉大なる主君の降臨に、フレイムバーズのボルテージは一気にゲージを振りきった。
lines.english: The descent of their great lord sent the Flame Birds' excitement clean off the gauge.

lines.japanese: 両手を振りあげ飛びあがり、肩を抱きあい拍手喝采。胴上げ、万歳、モッシュ＆ダイブ。
lines.english: They flung up their hands and leaped, locked arms around one another's shoulders, applauded and roared. They tossed him in the air, cheered, moshed, and stage-dived.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハ、前座は終わり今こそ主役の登場だ！　歌劇は正にクライマックス！　偉大なる王の登場に、頬杖をついた観客も席を立つ。さあ歓声だ！　喝采だ！　全ての意識を俺に集めろ！」
lines.english: “Hah-hah-hah! The opening act is over; now the star takes the stage! The opera reaches its climax! At the entrance of the great king, even the spectator sitting chin in hand rises from his seat. Now cheer! Applaud! Fix every scrap of your attention upon me!”

lines.japanese: 「いまこそまさに！　カーニバル！」
lines.english: “Now is the hour! Carnival!”

lines.japanese: 「えー」
lines.english: “Boo.”

lines.japanese: 派手に掌底を打ちあわせた鳳翔がぎょろりと俺を睨むので、もの恥ずかしげに俯くことでこちらの意思を伝えた。伝わらなかったけど。
lines.english: Kakeru Otori clapped his palms together with a theatrical crack and glared at me. I lowered my eyes with bashful embarrassment to communicate my opinion. It did not get through.

lines.japanese: 「ハァァ……ファルコンンン……俺の部下たちが世話になったらしいなァ」
lines.english: “Haaaaah... Falconnnn... I hear you've been looking after my men.”

lines.japanese: 「いや全然」
lines.english: “Not in the slightest.”

lines.japanese: 「ひとまず礼は言っておこう」
lines.english: “For now, you have my thanks.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、おい、ひとの話聞けよ」
lines.english: “Hey. Listen when people talk to you.”

lines.japanese: 「俺は誰だ！」
lines.english: “Who am I?!”

lines.japanese: わがままエンペラーは俺の言葉を無視して振りかえった。皇帝！　皇帝！　フレイムバーズが足を踏みならして騒ぎたてる。
lines.english: The selfish emperor ignored me and spun toward the others. Emperor! Emperor! The Flame Birds stomped their feet and thundered the name.

lines.japanese: 「あいつらは何だ！」
lines.english: “And what are they?!”

lines.japanese: 「はーい、皇帝の居ない間に空を飛ぼうと夢見ちゃった、憐れなゴキブリちゃんたちでーす」
lines.english: “Those are the poor little cockroaches who dreamed of flying while the Emperor was away!”

lines.japanese: ああ、楽しそうだなあ森里君。
lines.english: Morisato was certainly having fun.

lines.japanese: 「シシッ、シシシッ……おとなしく俺の下に這いつくばっていればいいものを、ヴァガヤロ、てめえら全員アメンチアの夢に惑わされたとでも言い訳する気かァ……？」
lines.english: “Shish! Shishishi... You should have stayed meekly groveling beneath me, fools. Do you all mean to plead that Amentia's dream led you astray...?”

lines.japanese: 「ぐ、ぐぐっ……」
lines.english: “G-grrr...”

lines.japanese: 「ひっ、ひいっ！　ヤバいって、あいつはマジでヤバいよ！」
lines.english: “E-eek! This is bad! That man is seriously bad news!”

lines.japanese: 「だが俺は許さない。王に逆らう者の末路は磔刑と決まっている。おまえたちに用意された磔台は、蟲の群がる街路灯だ！　ヒハハハ、ヒャッハハハハァ！」
lines.english: “But I shall not forgive you. Those who defy the king are destined for crucifixion. The crosses prepared for you are the streetlamps where insects swarm! Hee-hah-hah! Hyah-hah-hah-hah!”

lines.japanese: 「さあ叫べ憐れなカスどもよ！　嘆け喚け地に額ずいて命を乞え！　無様に俺から逃げ惑え！　いくぞテメェらぁぁー！　キッシャアアー！！」
lines.english: “Now scream, you miserable dregs! Lament and wail! Press your brows to the earth and beg for life! Flee me in disgrace! Come, you bastards! Kishaaaa!”

lines.japanese: 「うるしゃいわ」
lines.english: “Shut uuuuup.”

lines.japanese: 俺は前屈姿勢に構えたカケルくんの頭を叩きおとした。
lines.english: I smacked Kakeru on the head as he crouched into a runner's stance.

lines.japanese: 「むっ、なんだファルコン……貴様、俺たちの敵に回るつもりか」
lines.english: “Hm? What is it, Falcon? Do you mean to turn against us?”

lines.japanese: 「うるさい、おまえが現れなければ平和のうちに解決する予定だったんだよ。この期に及んで引っかきまわすな。ほら帰れ帰れ」
lines.english: “Quiet. This was going to end peacefully until you appeared. Don't stir everything up at the last second. Go on. Go home.”

lines.japanese: 「フン、相変わらずつまらないやつだ。いいぜ、だったらおまえが俺をイカせてみろよ。まずは勃たせることが出来たなら、おまえだけと踊ってやろう」
lines.english: “Hmph. Dull as ever. Fine, then—you make me come. Get me up first, and I'll dance with you alone.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、そんなつもり微塵もないから。ね、いい年してぱじゅかしい真似せずに、今すぐ帰りなさい。でないと妹にチクるぞ？　おまえ俺と違ってドが付くぐらいのシスコンらしいじゃん」
lines.english: “No, no. I have absolutely no intention of doing that. You're a grown man, so stop doing embawassing things and go home this instant. Or I'll tell your sister. Apparently you're even more pathologically obsessed with yours than I am with mine.”

lines.japanese: 「ハハハ！　いいだろうファルコン、どうしても敵に回りたいのなら、今夜はおまえとパーティーだ！　レッツ・シンギン・ソング、歌い踊れ七面鳥よ！　キシャアー！」
lines.english: “Hah-hah-hah! Very well, Falcon. If you insist on becoming my enemy, tonight I shall party with you! Let's sing a song! Sing and dance, my turkey! Kishaaa!”

lines.japanese: 「うおっ、ムキになるなこのどシスコン！　おい腐れパンクスども、仕方ないからここは一時共同で――」
lines.english: “Whoa! Don't get all worked up, you sister-obsessed freak! Hey, you rotten punks! Looks like we'll have to join forces for the moment—”

lines.japanese: しかし振りかえったときには、Ｒ－ウイングの連中は一人も残っていなかった。
lines.english: But when I turned around, not one member of R-Wing remained.

lines.japanese: 「えっ、に、逃げ……ちゃった？」
lines.english: “Huh? Th-they... ran away?”

lines.japanese: がら空きになったガード下の一方面。反対側に恐る恐る首を向けると、にたりと笑ったフレイムバーズの連中がいた。
lines.english: One side of the underpass lay completely vacant. I slowly, fearfully turned my head toward the other. The Flame Birds stood there grinning at me.

lines.japanese: 「ヘイＹＯ成田君！　たまにはあんたと遊んでみるのも悪くねえなァ、ハッハー！」
lines.english: “Hey, yo, Narita! Might be fun to play with you for a change! Hah-hah!”

lines.japanese: 「ヒャハー！　いいぜファルコン、俺をエレクトさせてみろォ！　今夜のエジャキュレーションが待ちどおしいぜ、クワァーハーッ！」
lines.english: “Hyah-hah! Come on, Falcon—make me elect! I can hardly wait for tonight's ejaculation! Kwaaah-hah!”

lines.japanese: 「うへぇ、どうして俺ばっかりぃ～！　カンベンしてくれぇ～」
lines.english: “Ugh! Why does this always happen to me?! Give me a break!”

lines.japanese: ８０人はいると思われる集団とのイカれた鬼ごっこは朝まで続いた。
lines.english: My deranged game of tag with a mob of what must have been eighty people lasted until dawn.

lines.japanese: 先にへばったカケルくんがハゲの車に乗って家に帰るまで、俺はがむしゃらに走り続けた。
lines.english: I ran for my life until Kakeru, the first to give out, climbed into the bald man's car and went home.

lines.japanese: 足をがくがく言わせつつ、なんとか家に戻ったときには、朝食の準備をしていた小鳩に夜遊びはやめなさいと怒られた。
lines.english: By the time I staggered home on trembling legs, Kobato was preparing breakfast. She scolded me and told me to stop staying out all night.

lines.japanese: 後日譚。結局Ｒ－ウイングの連中は、舌戦の中で自分たちとの共通点を見出し、フレイムバーズと仲直りしたらしい。
lines.english: An epilogue: in the course of their war of words, R-Wing apparently discovered how much they had in common with the Flame Birds and made peace with them after all.

lines.japanese: めでたくなしめでたくなし。
lines.english: And nobody lived happily ever after.
